e2f9503e43f3bb1947bbbe9bf4729f62f8434e1d.summary: Symantec (Broadcom) describes Carderbee, a previously unknown APT group that used the legitimate Cobra DocGuard software in a supply chain attack to deploy the Korplug (PlugX) backdoor. Most victims are in Hong Kong, with some in other parts of Asia. The attackers used malware signed with a Microsoft certificate. Symantec could not link the activity to a known group, so it named the actor Carderbee, and did not find evidence tying it to Budworm. Malicious activity was seen on about 100 computers, while the software was installed on about 2,000. The activity began in April 2023.
